notes: Profile: EU-headquartered legal search vendor focused on cross-jurisdiction contract search and due diligence. Large multilingual corpora (contracts, filings, precedents).
Scale: target index ~250M documents over 18 months; active corpus ~50M doc baseline for POCs. Concerned about indexing throughput and storage cost for dense embeddings.
Language coverage: priority languages EN, FR, DE, ES, NL, PT, IT, JA, ZH. Want per-language recall/precision tuning and per-language embeddings models if helpful.

Architecture preference: two-stage retrieval -> candidate set via ANN on embeddings, then lightweight neural reranker per language to improve precision. Interested in Redwood suggestions for reranker quantization and batching to meet latency SLOs.
Latency / SLOs: target 95th percentile end-to-end <200ms for reranking for short queries (top-k=10). Will accept staged fallback to <100ms retrieval-only if reranker overloaded.
Cost sensitivity: target cost-per-query (avg) < $0.02. Procurement will pressure on per-token and per-embedding billing; wants predictable unit economics for peak and steady state.
Security: must maintain EU data residency for embeddings and logs; SSO (SAML) + audit logs + KMS. Compliance checklist requested (SOC2/ISO).
Existing stack: in-house Elastic + custom ANN + Python reranker microservice; unhappy with recall on cross-lingual queries and expensive CPU reranking at scale.

Decision criteria: (1) per-language recall lift vs current baseline, (2) p95 latency under SLO on 50M index, (3) TCO modelling for 12/24 month runway, (4) enterprise security/compliance and contractual SLA.
AE notes: Elena ran cost sensitivity spreadsheet; Jordan to run initial perf tests. Customer asked: 'Can you show per-language ROC/precision curves and delta-vs-baseline on our sample prompts?'
Quote requests: procurement asked for committed Dedicated pricing with burst + optional private deployment pricing (VPC + on-prem connector).
Tone: pragmatic, engineering-first; heavy emphasis on reproducible evals and per-language test sets.
